resolved.Name: S2b
resolved.Title: slow sink beyond timeout (3s, timeout 2s)
resolved.Description: soar answers after 3 s while the gateway gives up after 2 s. The receiver still processes every request it got, so soar sees duplicates; that is expected and reported (dup_raw), not a failure. A receiver honouring Idempotency-Key would store none of them (dup_stored).

ExtraChecks.Note: duplicates carry the same idem key

notes: kill = SIGKILL; graceful stop = SIGTERM. kill -9 is not power loss (page cache survives).
